Messages.Author: Shane Travis
Messages.Body:
Joseph Cheek (jch...@eworld.com) wrote:
: As I understand it, First Strike cancels out even a dodge (scenario: muddled

: vampire hunter vs. vampire with celerity and a lot of dodge cards). My
: opponent claimed that dodges worked even against first strikes. Which is
: correct?

Your opponent is. In Jyhad, the order of strike resolution is currently:

Combat Ends (when played)
Dodge
First strike
All other effects.

In other words: if he dodges nothing can get to him (unless you have
additionl strikes and he doesn't.

Messages.Author: Shane Travis
Messages.Body:
Michael Whitbread (mw...@earthsciences.uq.edu.au) wrote:
: When a vampire dodges, are his retainers protected from the strike? I think

: they are but I am not sure.

They are not. Under 12.3.1, Employ Retainer: "The only damage that can
be dealt to [a minion] is _ranged_ damage ... This damage cannot be
prevented by dodges or any other intervention."

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Michael Whitbread <mw...@earthsciences.uq.edu.au> writes:

>When a vampire dodges, are his retainers protected from the strike? I think
>they are but I am not sure.

No. Nothing, absolutely nothing, can protect a retainer from a strike,
if the strike resolves. (Combat Ends or sending the opposing striker to
Torpor with First Strike will protect the Retainer).

Reference:

12.3.1

Retainers cannot use equipment, deal damage in combat, or act
independently of the minion they are augmenting. They can be destroyed
(burned) in combat by suffering as much damage as they have life. The only
damage that can be dealt to them is ranged damage (see Combat, Sec. 15),
and any time ranged damage is dealt to a minion, the Methuselah
controlling the minion dealing the ranged damage may choose to apply all
of it to either the minion or to a retainer on the minion. This damage
cannot be prevented by Dodge or any other intervention. If a retainer is
not burned in a given combat, its wounds are considered healed. Retainers
are also burned when the minion they are employed by is burned.
--
